title: Deviations from the NTK Regime in CNNs under Joint Depth-Width Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2611.25624v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The concentration and training-time constancy of the neural tangent kernel (NTK) depend on the interplay between network width, depth, and initialization. While joint depth-width scaling has been studied in fully-connected, residual, and recurrent networks, its effects in convolutional neural networks (CNNs) remain less understood. We investigate these effects numerically in CNNs, examining NTK dispersion at initialization and kernel rotation during training. Let depth $L$ be the number of convolutional layers, and width $C$ the number of channels per layer. We find that NTK dispersion increases with $L/C$ in the critical and chaotic initialization regimes, but remains small in the ordered regime. At critical initialization, dispersion curves approximately collapse as a function of $L/C$, suggesting a nontrivial joint scaling regime. translated_title: 联合深度-宽度缩放下卷积神经网络对NTK机制的偏离
translated_abstract: 神经正切核（NTK）的集中性与训练时间恒定性取决于网络宽度、深度和初始化之间的相互作用。尽管联合深度-宽度缩放已在全连接网络、残差网络和循环网络中得到研究，但其在卷积神经网络（CNN）中的影响仍知之甚少。我们在CNN中通过数值方法研究这些影响，考察初始化时的NTK离散度以及训练过程中的核旋转。设深度 $L$ 为卷积层的数量，宽度 $C$ 为每层的通道数。我们发现，在临界和混沌初始化区域中，NTK离散度随 $L/C$ 的增大而增加，但在有序区域中保持较小。在临界初始化下，离散度曲线作为 $L/C$ 的函数近似坍缩，这表明存在一个非平凡的联合缩放区域。在训练过程中，核旋转通常随 $L/C$ 的增大而增加，即使在初始（原文在此处截断）的有序区域中也是如此。
tldr: 该论文通过数值实验揭示了卷积神经网络中NTK离散度与训练时的核旋转均随深度与宽度之比（L/C）增长，且在临界初始化下离散度曲线随L/C近似坍缩，表明CNN存在偏离NTK机制的非平凡联合深度-宽度缩放区域。
en_tdlr: This paper numerically shows that in CNNs, both NTK dispersion and kernel rotation during training increase with the depth-to-width ratio L/C, and dispersion curves approximately collapse as a function of L/C at critical initialization, revealing a nontrivial joint depth-width scaling regime where CNNs deviate from the NTK regime.
